about_the_game:
Dash into a fast, stylish arcade run!
Pick from 6 unique characters, play solo, co-op, or PvP, and climb online leaderboards to prove your skills.

Master multiple game modes packed with speed, action, and surprises. Earn achievements, unlock bonus content, and grow stronger. Cloud saves keep your progress safe, so you can pick up right where you left off.

📸 Pause anytime, snap epic shots in Photo Mode, and share your best moments with the world.

Whether you’re chasing high scores, battling friends, or exploring secrets, this game delivers fast gameplay, competitive energy, and endless replayability.

linux_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Ubuntu 20.04 or SteamOS 3.0
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-4160 or AMD FX-6300
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 950 or AMD Radeon R7 370 (2GB VRAM)
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 6 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Any sound card compatible with ALSA
  • VR Support: No
  • Additional Notes: Requires Vulkan Support. For SteamOS, make sure the system is up to date with the latest drivers. Broadband Internet Connection for online features.
linux_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Ubuntu 22.04 or SteamOS 3.0
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-8400 or AMD Ryzen 5 2600
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1060 or AMD Radeon RX 580 (6GB VRAM). Mesa driver version 22.0 or newer is highly recommended.
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 6 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Any sound card compatible with ALSA
  • VR Support: No
  • Additional Notes: Requires Vulkan Support. For SteamOS, make sure the system is up to date with the latest drivers. Broadband Internet Connection for online features.
